Freeze a study's pull from a master view

Source: R/master_freeze.R
freeze_study_pull.Rd

Sources are not time-travelable, so the release, not the warehouse, is the record of what a study read. freeze_study_pull() publishes the pull as an immutable parquet release with publish_dataset(), with its provenance written into the file's own metadata: the SQL model commit, the ids of the corrections applied, when the pull read, the parity verdict it passed, the cohort definition and stage counts, and the study configuration's checksum as recorded when the pull ran. Because the provenance is part of the bytes, the release's SHA-256 covers it, and a release can never exist without it. Read it back with read_pull_provenance().

Usage

freeze_study_pull(
  pull,
  path,
  dir,
  dataset_id,
  extract_date = Sys.Date(),
  study_config,
  datasets_dir
)

Arguments

pull

A master_pull from pull_master().

path

Character. Path to the study configuration file given to pull_master(); it must be unchanged since the pull.

dir, dataset_id, extract_date

As for publish_dataset().

study_config

Deprecated; use path.

datasets_dir

Deprecated; use dir.

Value

Invisibly, the release, as returned by publish_dataset().

Details

The configuration must be unchanged since the pull: if its checksum no longer matches the one pull_master() recorded, nothing is published. A pull awaiting chart review is refused.

Retrying the same pull returns the same release. A distinct pull with identical data carries different provenance, so it becomes its own release.

The retained pull holds patient values. It belongs in the study's data folder under the same rules as the built dataset, never in a repository.

See also

read_pull_provenance(), pull_master(), publish_dataset()

Examples

# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("duckdb", quietly = TRUE) &&
      requireNamespace("arrow", quietly = TRUE)) {
  # Synthetic data; no PHI.
  con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())
  DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "master_demo", data.frame(
    mrn = "SYN101", encounter_date = as.Date("2010-03-01"), proc = "CABG", age = 62
  ))
  DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "master_demo_corrections_applied", data.frame(
    correction_id = character(), mrn = character(), encounter_date = as.Date(character())
  ))
  DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "master_demo_deployment", data.frame(sql_commit = "abc1234"))
  DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "master_demo_parity", data.frame(
    sql_commit = "abc1234", verdict = "pass", verified_at = Sys.time()
  ))
  config <- tempfile(fileext = ".yaml")
  writeLines("study: st0000", config)
  q <- cohort_query("proc = 'CABG'", as.Date(c("2000-01-01", "2024-07-31")))
  pull <- pull_master(con, "master_demo", q, var_cols = "age", path = config,
                      dialect = "duckdb")
  published <- tempfile("published-")
  dir.create(published)
  release <- freeze_study_pull(pull, config, published, "st0000_pull")
  read_pull_provenance(file.path(published, release$file))$sql_commit
  DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
  unlink(c(config, published), recursive = TRUE)
}
